aesthetic: Swiss Editorial Folio — warm-cream ground with dark-navy punctuation, Futura/Palatino pairing evokes mid-century Graphis annual typography
chromaticArc: Opens on warm cream, navy dividers at slides 10, 26, and 42 create three editorial acts; terracotta accents intensify through the middle third then recede, closing on cream with a navy coda
gridStrategy: Centred-axis compositions (cols 12–48) dominate, with monument layouts for openers, sidebar-L and sidebar-R alternating for body slides, and full-width splits reserved for code and table slides

fontStrategy.secondarySlides: Palatino used for body text on all slides; Futura reserved for headings and labels; SF Mono for code blocks

accentStrategy: Thin 1px terracotta lines divide title from body zones on 40% of slides; 2-col-wide navy bars punctuate sidebar layouts; dotted rules on table slides
